findings.location: items/alg-bracketing-zoom-strong-wolfe-search.md, ## Definition: initial-point data and the expansion/zoom Armijo tests
findings.evidence: The inputs include f, x, p, c1, c2, E and Z, and the procedure explicitly evaluates only trial values phi(t), phi'(t). The direction check computes the initial directional derivative, but no instruction evaluates phi(0)=f(x) or supplies that baseline value, even though the expansion and zoom Armijo branches compare against phi(0). The finite-return lemma bounds trial evaluations and excludes initial-point data, but does not specify how this baseline objective value is obtained. Specify an initial evaluation of phi(0) or make it a supplied input. The assigned consumer depends on this procedure.
